discovery: RUN/*parent*.{md,json}, four disjoint first-character partitions, none truncated

classes.DIRECT_LEDGER_LINK: Linked from a rendered README ledger row; reported through that row.
classes.TRANSITIVE_REFERENCE: Filename referenced in the text of a direct or transitive record; covered by that record’s scope, not separately promoted.
classes.README_NONLEDGER_LINK: Linked from a README section outside the ledger table.
classes.CHECKPOINT_REFERENCED_HISTORICAL: Referenced by numbered parent checkpoints only. Historical disposition at its own exact scope; NOT promoted into report results; may be superseded by later dispositions.
classes.PROCESS_CONTROL_OR_OVERLAY: Direction/finding/overlay/control record; governs process scope; carried with deviations where applicable.
classes.UNMAPPED_HISTORICAL_PARENT_RECORD: Parent record not linked or referenced by the ledger chain, README or checkpoints. Its own exact scope governs; it is NOT promoted into the report results.

limits: Filename/reference metadata classification; not semantic re-review. Records created after this census are outside it by construction and must be listed by exact filename in the final report.
